fullDescription: A standalone testimonial COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: Two rows of compact cards scrolling in opposite directions, edge-faded, pausing on hover. Each row duplicates its card set so a translateX of -50% loops seamlessly, with the copy marked aria-hidden. The edge fade is a mask so it works over any background rather than being a gradient overlay matched to one. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A self-contained testimonial component. Two rows of compact cards scrolling in opposite directions, edge-faded, pausing on hover. Each row duplicates its card set so a translateX of -50% loops seamlessly, with the copy marked aria-hidden. The edge fade is a mask so it works over any background rather than being a gradient overlay matched to one. The page contains the component and nothing else, so it can be lifted straight into a section.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Component
Each row duplicates its card set so a translateX of -50% loops seamlessly, with the copy marked aria-hidden. The edge fade is a mask so it works over any background rather than being a gradient overlay matched to one.

### Responsive
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.

### Reduced motion
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Two rows of compact cards scrolling in opposite directions, edge-faded, pausing on hover.

### Componente
Initial-based avatars with no image dependency

### Componente
Reduced-motion fallback that changes the layout, not just the timing
